---
title: "On a Class of Anisotropic Sobolev Spaces, and an Extension of an Elementary Integral"
subtitle: >-
  This was my master's thesis for the CMU math honors program. They include my
  published work on anisotropic Sobolev spaces, along with exposition of an
  extension of Dieudonne's Cauchy integral, or regulated integral. I extended
  this integral to work in very general settings and integrate functions taking
  values in locally convex spaces.
date: "2024-07-31"
